parameters.content:
## AliExpress Multi-Region Search, Store & Review Scraper

**Actor:** [AliExpress Multi-Region Search, Store & Review Scraper](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/aliexpress-multi-region-search-store-and-review)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/aliexpress-multi-region-search-store-and-review-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `searchQueries` (array)
- `productIds` (array)
- `storeIds` (array)
- `urls` (array)
- `region` (string)
- `currency` (string)
- `language` (string)
- `sortBy` (string)
- `priceMin` (number)
- `priceMax` (number)
- `ratingMin` (number)

### Output fields
- `title` (Title)
- `productId` (Product Id)
- `salePrice` (Sale Price)
- `originalPrice` (Original Price)
- `currencyCode` (Currency Code)
- `discountPercent` (Discount Percent)
- `rating` (Rating)
- `ordersCount` (Orders Count)
- `shipFromCountry` (Ship From Country)
- `productUrl` (Product Url)
- `isSponsored` (Is Sponsored)

description: AliExpress product search export: runs the AliExpress Multi-Region Search, Store & Review Scraper Apify Actor, returns title, salePrice, originalPrice, discountPercent, rating and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
